title_sq: Prane Zogut Te Zi, Tek E88 Construction, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Me Orientim Perfekt!!
description_sq: Prane Zogut Te Zi, Tek E88 Construction, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Me Orientim Perfekt, Ideal Per Banim Apo Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 8 te nje pallati 8 katesh dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto 143.97 m2 nga te cilat 123.90 m2 siperfaqe neto. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni i ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone. Kompleksi ku ndodhet prona eshte i sapo perfunduar, me cilesine me te mire te punimeve, me fasade te termoizoluar dhe hapesira rekreative. Orientimi i prones eshte nga Lindja-Jugu-Perendimi, cka mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti ofron nje pamje te lire nga te gjitha anet dhe zona ku ndodhet prona eshte nje nga me te kerkuarat ne Tirane duke ofruar te gjitha kushtet per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Prona disponon dhe nje post parkimi ne cmimin ekstra 20.000 euro.
title_en: Near the Black Bird, at E88 Construction, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with perfect orientation!!
description_en: Near the Black Bird, at E88 Construction, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with perfect orientation, ideal for residence or investment!!! The apartment is located on the 8th floor of an 8-story building and has a gross area of ​​143.97 m2, of which 123.90 m2 is a net area. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen area, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The complex where the property is located is newly completed, with the best quality of work, with thermally insulated facades and recreational spaces. The orientation of the property is from East-South-West, which enables natural lighting throughout the day. The apartment offers a clear view from all sides and the area where the property is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana offering all the conditions for a comfortable and peaceful life. The property also has a parking post at an extra price of 20,000 euros.
